acceptance_criteria: Add a detector adapter domain boundary for replay/shadow frame metadata.
Add a stub detector adapter that runs without camera, GPU, model weights, raw media, or production datasets.
Detector results may include validated DetectorObservation entries only.
Detector result decisions are limited to safe non-authoritative states and never PASS or NG.
Missing/unapproved model state returns NOT_EVALUATED with model approval blockers.
Observation labels, confidence, bbox, model ref, and evidence ref are validated through existing domain contracts.
Add a JSON schema/contract for detector result payload shape.
Invalid observations or raw-media source URIs are rejected explicitly with ValidationError.

No live camera, model weights, TensorRT engines, MLOps artifacts, raw customer/factory data, production deploy, secrets, destructive migrations, product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject changes are introduced.
Existing Flange QC v2 unit/contract tests, product CI, and full repository tests pass.
